description: This Swift source file defines a SwiftUI View named GatewayQuickSetupSheet. The view provides a user interface for connecting to a gateway device, displaying its details, handling connection attempts, and dismissing the sheet. It integrates environment objects for app model and gateway control, manages local state for connection progress and errors, and offers UI elements like text, buttons, toggles, and progress indicators.

classes.name: GatewayQuickSetupSheet
classes.description: A SwiftUI View for quick setup and connection to a gateway device with user feedback and control.

methods.name: bestCandidate
methods.description: Retrieves the first available gateway discovery candidate from the gateway controller, prioritizing the first discovered gateway.
